t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Indi kyimisho, O Nyamuhanga waghe Ngoko wanyihangika okwikuminya n'okwik-wanza n'olwanzo lunene Ngaminya okon-dambi'eno ovolo vwaghe n'ovutoki vwaghe Ovusama vwaghe n'ovungi vwaghu. Sihali wundi Nyamuhanga oyuti'iwe Oyukasavula omonavi, oyuliho okwiye musa.
